350462539.query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM contributions
        WHERE 1=1
        AND ST_Intersects(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((8.407288 49.346599, 8.839874 49.346599, 8.839874 49.532339, 8.407288 49.532339, 8.407288 49.346599))', 4326))
        AND valid_to > '2026-01-01'::timestamptz
        AND tags @> $1 AND ((status_geom_type).geom_type = 'Polygon' OR (status_geom_type).geom_type = 'MultiPolygon') OR tags @> $2 AND ((status_geom_type).geom_type = 'Point' OR (status_geom_type).geom_type = 'LineString');
